                                💡 AI Executive Summary: Key News Insights
                            </div>
                            <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="100%" style="background-color: #F8FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #FF9900; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-left-width: 4px;">
                                <tr>
                                    <td style="padding: 20px 24px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.7em; text-align: justify;">
                                        <div style='margin-top:2px; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; color:#0F172A; letter-spacing:-0.3px;'>1. 전력망 연계 지연에 따른 빅테크 계약 철회와 북미·유럽 AIDC 개발 차질의 현실화</div>영국 전력망(National Grid)의 송전 용량 포화와 계통 연계가 2030년대까지 지체될 것이라는 우려가 커지자 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiggFBVV95cUxOMFhMV3pqdjFFY3Bjb25veXRwcE85eTg5TUdKYThJbmtTNUtidEU3Sm9FLU5XWlkyb203Qi1XdU9zM014Y0xwNDdsZkY5VXF1bTBIaVIyTEFqdjNkUV9Va2MyckpHVC1yOC1DX2lTdjJKYTZMLUU5cVpRQW41bVNveG1n%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Microsoft%20pulls%20data%20center%20deal%20as%20UK%20power%20delays%20loom&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[1]</a>, 마이크로소프트(MS)가 영국 에식스주 라우턴에서 추진하던 엔스케일(Nscale)과의 대규모 AI 데이터센터 임대 계약을 전격 철회함 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMixwFBVV95cUxNMmVDUVQyZjhnbFN2MHQ1MHVPMHVpLVVsUFE1aU44Y2QzMUx2a25MRXR5OWtkTGd5RkViaG9fM3lZcnFHblYyT2xMeGZ3MHI3NkFjQ0FhdWFVRWlmdHlPRDRFRVRsclFpbUExakpiN3Z4aGMtODdDb09Mb0xXbnIxdU04ZmQ3UTEyTkhQd2EyMFhDNzQzYVgzZG9FeDlNYTJTanNOOThVSGRTb2RnRWdCajBVXzFMcDB4MWZpbXR1STMzZ1JaOXRr%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Microsoft%20pulls%20out%20of%20UK%20data%20center%20deal%20with%20Nscale%2C%20Telegraph%20reports&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[2]</a>. 이번 계약 파기는 30억 달러(약 4.01조 원) 규모의 기업공개(IPO)를 준비하던 엔스케일에 심각한 타격을 입혔으며 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMilgFBVV95cUxOQ1g0LVpLNUxPRy1XZVdTZTRVZ0NaVXRfaXM2VjVlN0hwcVdtRWd3dzRkVEY0UGIweHZzaXp0dUpFNFY0dWs4anVReUUzNl9tQmVqTDZJelQ1TDhTOEh3dm15SjBJLTRiTi1WOWQ3akRtQ2lwVHQwb1NuX25yRDZjeV9ORkdQdEhsRlFud2NjTXlaZFNvOXc%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Nscale%20Faces%20IPO%20Setback%20as%20Microsoft%20Reportedly%20Scraps%20Essex%20AI%20Deal&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[3]</a>, MS 역시 단기 연산 용량 확보에 큰 차질을 빚게 됨 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiakFVX3lxTFBHREJLcVpSS1JWUlhmQ3diWlctRGxFc3lIc2EzOFFzLWdaWjNlR3ZEZC01bUNTNU1BS0hGX2tWemJQRzNpZVBQUml1SHFBZm9PMjM5S1ptbnZJSDZSSjI2aURzNzQ4eHJYR3c%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=%EB%A7%88%EC%9D%B4%ED%81%AC%EB%A1%9C%EC%86%8C%ED%94%84%ED%8A%B8%2C%20Nscale%EA%B3%BC%EC%9D%98%20%EC%98%81%EA%B5%AD%20%EB%8D%B0%EC%9D%B4%ED%84%B0%EC%84%BC%ED%84%B0%20%EA%B3%84%EC%95%BD%20%EC%B2%A0%ED%9A%8C&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[4]</a>. 동시에 영국 경쟁시장청(CMA)이 클라우드 독과점 완화와 전환 장벽 해소를 위해 AWS와 MS에 대한 압박 수위를 높이면서 규제 리스크까지 가중됨 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiwwFBVV95cUxQV25lSTFVcDY5d3dzS1hqN2gxVjhUQVo3cDJfNm5RcmU1VXZJRDVHb3ctbVh4b1pIQVRocVhEUFdIWnFhQnZtM0dkVDBGR0N4Y0Z2QVdKZGlES0NwUmM0VUxJRmVvSlMxRW5vNGtVYjlHMnRHR2pkcURic29PZmpZaGhNdlA4Mm9vUVdLNlFMNHJOdE4yeXNKRG50b2k0RTVtNnVOdzZXZFVZSjA0Q2M2Yjk3MlRMZDJWXzBYQ3V6NlFndXc%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=AWS%2C%20Microsoft%20can%20do%20more%20to%20address%20cloud%20services%20barriers%2C%20UK%20competition%20wa&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[5]</a>. 이러한 인프라 병목은 북미로도 확산되어 올해 미국 내에서만 최소 47곳의 데이터센터 개발 프로젝트가 전력난과 비용 급증으로 지연되거나 철회된 것으로 집계됨 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiWkFVX3lxTE5TdWRKNnJLZFk0NlNRT0JHSkZmZEUwbmZqMTFDdXBFb213Z2tBd3gtWTQwWHNSVFdyUGVLMndMR3pqbmttWUdUQlJVazl6b0NEQVVxOWRxTm1XUQ%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=%E7%BE%8E%20%EB%8D%B0%EC%9D%B4%ED%84%B0%EC%84%BC%ED%84%B0%2047%EA%B3%B3%2C%20%EC%98%AC%ED%95%B4%20%EC%82%AC%EC%97%85%20%EC%A0%9C%EB%8F%99%E2%80%A6%22%EB%B9%84%EC%9A%A9%20%EB%B6%80%EB%8B%B4%20%EC%BB%A4%EC%A7%84%EB%8B%A4%22&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[6]</a>. 실제로 MS는 위스콘신주 마운트플레전트 부지의 데이터센터 건립 동수를 당초 계획보다 축소하기로 결정했으며 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMijAFBVV95cUxNMHBsdFdES1NNUXhndVJHdU14VmVnSGFmYkJKY2pNTUJyQjhaVFZXY1d1NHJJOElsdTJDUlpNTmF5ZkwxZnVkX2tLT2k4cWZEMVAyS0dySzRzNkp2UVVORmtfTExuOHVRaW12MlhNVXZFN0hrUDc4NS1VdEt0d3hPcWtuMW4yRnFZeEJLZw%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Microsoft%20Planning%20to%20Build%20Fewer%20Data%20Centers%20in%20Mount%20Pleasant&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[7]</a>, 미국 내 10조 달러(약 1경 3,378조 원) 규모의 AI 인프라 계획 중 실제 완공 비율은 35%에 불과할 것이라는 관측이 제기됨 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiZ0FVX3lxTE5HZm9LU3dKcGV6cU1ETUU3dnJ4bjAweWFqRVY0b01ZSnZGWUw3VG1xRkN3NXZ5clpoSlhuQmVOODBabi04QVJxRHZ0RDhXSDd0dEJGQVlrWG1pVXNkTDA0elI2YTFCWkU%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=%22%E7%BE%8E%2010%EC%A1%B0%EB%8B%AC%EB%9F%AC%20AI%20%ED%88%AC%EC%9E%90%EB%B6%90%EC%97%90%20%EA%B7%A0%EC%97%B4%E2%80%A6%EB%8D%B0%EC%9D%B4%ED%84%B0%EC%84%BC%ED%84%B0%20%EA%B3%84%ED%9A%8D%2035%25%EB%A7%8C%20%EC%8B%A4%ED%98%84%20%EA%B0%80%EB%8A%A5%22&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[8]</a>. 결국 송배전망 확충 없는 설비 증설은 한계에 봉착했으며, 계통 접속권 확보가 빅테크의 AI 경쟁력을 가르는 선결 과제로 부상함.<div style='margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; color:#0F172A; letter-spacing:-0.3px;'>2. 전시 하이브리드 타깃이 된 디지털 인프라와 소버린 클라우드 물리 안보 강화</div>우크라이나군이 1,000대 이상의 공격 드론을 동원해 러시아 상트페테르부르크의 전략 거점을 공습함 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%2FCBMiswFBVV95cUxNeUFCc3Y1TXhCdTJWZVhLUTlhb3hPN3JBZ2dLbU5hRnJTOVJWcHlfVDdJUzByM2Nmb25aLWJDcHNXYTBlTlhXeFFQcGE5WUJEeTZOamNtWHVsRjlYRmJGc2lhYzNBQURzTmJ0LW1XNVlpOHdkUWx3WGhIekN6UlBFZEtXTDZkTXV0TzdrLVFTMzBtWFl3X1ZLbjNtMFpzNjNONi1IUVVXSzgtU0otSUZOdjVDdw%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Ukraine%20launches%20more%20than%201%2C000%20drones%20at%20Russian%20oil%20terminals%2C%20data%20centers%20i&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[9]</a>. 이번 공습으로 유류 저장시설 및 변전소와 함께 러시아 최대 플랫폼 기업 브이콘탁테(VK)의 메가 데이터센터가 직격당해 국지적 정전과 광범위한 서비스 마비가 발생함 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Massive%20drone%20attack%20on%20St.%20Petersburg%3A%20Fuel%20depots%20burning%2C%20VK%20data%20center%20and%20&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[10]</a>. 핵심 서버 설비가 파괴되어 러시아 전역의 결제 및 온라인 플랫폼 서비스가 먹통이 되었으며 <a href='https://news-tracker.ywmoon1202.workers.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2Frss%2Farticles%%3Foc%3D5&amp;title=Drone%20Strike%20Hits%20Russia%E2%80%99s%20VKontakte%20Data%20Center%2C%20Knocking%20Services%20Offline%20as%20S&amp;cat=Summary_Ref' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7;
